yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ ākāsaṃ ākāsagataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ, kaṇṇacchiddaṃ nāsacchiddaṃ mukhadvāraṃ, yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ ajjhoharati… ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā ākāsadhātu.

sā pattaṃ gahetvā ākāse khipi. patto ākāse aṭṭhāsi

anusāsa brahme karuṇāyamāno, vivekadhammaṃ yam'ahaṃ vijaññaṃ, yath'āhaṃ ākāso'va abyāpajjamāno, idh'eva santo asito careyyaṃ.
odātakasiṇam'eko sañjānāti uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ advayaṃ appamāṇaṃ. ākāsakasiṇam'eko sañjānāti uddhaṃ adho tiriyaṃ advayaṃ appamāṇaṃ.

11046.synonym: aghagata, tuccha, tucchaka, ritta, rittaka, vivaragata

examples.text: yaṃ vā pan'aññam'pi kiñci ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ ākāsaṃ ākāsagataṃ, aghaṃ aghagataṃ, vivaraṃ vivaragataṃ, asamphuṭṭhaṃ maṃsalohitehi upādinnaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā ākāsadhātu.
seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, saradasamaye viddhe vigatavalāhake deve ādicco nabhaṃ abbhussakkamāno sabbaṃ ākāsagataṃ tamagataṃ abhivihacca bhāsate ca tapate ca virocati ca
yassa yassa hi raññā saddhiṃ gantu'kāmatācittaṃ uppajjati, so so ākāsagato'va hoti
atha kho rājā pasenadi kosalo viṭaṭūbhaṃ senāpatiṃ āmantesi, ko nu kho, senāpati, imaṃ kathāvatthuṃ rāj'antepure abbhudāhāsī'ti? sañjayo, mahārāja, brāhmaṇo ākāsagotto'ti.
vattu'kāmo haṃsānaṃ sīghavegatāya bārāṇasinagare rājanivesanassa uparibhāgaṃ sampattakāle daṭṭhaṭṭhānato daṇḍakaṃ vissajjetvā ākās'aṅgaṇe patitvā dvedhā bhijji.
pāsādo atisugandho hoti. yamakabhittiyā antare lohanāḷiṃ ṭhapetvā navabhūmikapāsādassa upari ākās'aṅgaṇe ratanamaṇḍapamatthake sukhumacchiddakaṃ jālaṃ baddhaṃ ahosi.

11051.meaning2: in the air; belonging to the sky or space

11053.meaning1: with an open roof; exposed to the sky

examples.text: atha kho, mahārāja ghaṭikāraṃ kumbhakāraṃ aḍḍhamāsaṃ pītisukhaṃ na vijahati, satt'āhaṃ mātāpitūnaṃ. atha kho, mahārāja, āvesanaṃ sabb'antaṃ temāsaṃ ākāsacchadanaṃ aṭṭhāsi, na devo'tivassi.
katame aṭṭha? ayaṃ, ānanda, mahāpathavī udake patiṭṭhitā, udakaṃ vāte patiṭṭhitaṃ, vāto ākāsaṭṭho. hoti kho so, ānanda, samayo, yaṃ mahāvātā vāyanti.

11055.meaning2: situated or living in the sky

examples.text: ākāsaṭṭhaṃ nāma bhaṇḍaṃ ākāsagataṃ hoti. moro vā kapiñjaro vā tittiro vā vaṭṭako vā, sāṭakaṃ vā veṭhanaṃ vā hiraññaṃ vā suvaṇṇaṃ vā chijjamānaṃ patati.
cha'y'imā, āvuso, dhātuyo tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena samma'd'akkhātā. katamā cha? pathavīdhātu, āpodhātu, tejodhātu, vāyodhātu, ākāsadhātu, viññāṇadhātu
yaṃ ajjhattaṃ paccattaṃ ākāsaṃ ākāsagataṃ upādinnaṃ, seyyath'idaṃ… yena ca asitapītakhāyitasāyitaṃ adhobhāgaṃ nikkhamati… ayaṃ vuccati, rāhula, ajjhattikā ākāsadhātu.

udakaṃ ce nissāya tiṭṭheyya, ye udakanissitā pāṇā te naṃ khādeyyuṃ. ākāsaṃ ce nissāya tiṭṭheyya, ye ākāsanissitā pāṇā te naṃ khādeyyuṃ. yaṃ yadeva hi sā, bhikkhave, gāvī niccammā nissāya tiṭṭheyya, ye tan'nissitā pāṇā te naṃ khādeyyuṃ.

11060.meaning1: like empty space; like open air
11060.commentary: (ANa) ākāsasamenā'ti alaggan'aṭṭhena c'eva apalibuddh'aṭṭhena ca ākāsasadisena. (THa) tadākāsasamaṃ cittan'ti ta'y'idaṃ mama cittaṃ ākāsasamaṃ katthaci alaggabhāvena ajjhattaṃ suṭṭhu samāhitaṃ

examples.text: ākāsasamaṃ, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvehi. ākāsasamañ'hi te, rāhula, bhāvanaṃ bhāvayato uppannā manāp'āmanāpā phassā cittaṃ na pariyādāya ṭhassanti.
tadākāsasamaṃ cittaṃ, ajjhattaṃ susamāhitaṃ, mā pāpacitte āsādi, aggikhandhaṃ'va pakkhimā.

11062.meaning1: dimension of infinite space; base of infinity of space
11062.commentary: (VISM) viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharatī'ti ettha pana n'āssa anto'ti anantaṃ. anantam'eva ānañcaṃ. viññāṇaṃ ānañcaṃ viññāṇ'ānañcan'ti avatvā viññāṇ'añcan'ti vuttaṃ. ayañ'h'ettha rūḷhīsaddo. taṃ viññāṇ'añcaṃ adhiṭṭhān'aṭṭhena āyatanamassa sasampayuttadhammassa jhānassa devānaṃ dev'āyatanam'ivā'ti viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ. sesaṃ purimasadisam'evā'ti.

examples.text: nissaṭṭhena āvuso, pañcahi indriyehi parisuddhena manoviññāṇena ananto ākāso'ti ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ neyyaṃ, anantaṃ viññāṇan'ti viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ neyyaṃ, n'atthi kiñcī'ti ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ neyyan'ti.
idha mayaṃ, bhante, yāva'd'eva ākaṅkhāma sabbaso rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅ'gamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā, ananto ākāso'ti ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāma

11063.meaning1: state of the dimension of infinite space; element of the base of infinity of space

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, yā c'āyaṃ, bhante, ābhādhātu yā ca subhadhātu yā ca ākās'ānañc'āyatanadhātu yā ca viññāṇ'añc'āyatanadhātu yā ca ākiñcaññ'āyatanadhātu yā ca n'evasaññ'ānāsaññ'āyatanadhātu yā ca saññāvedayitanirodhadhātu, imā nu kho, bhante, dhātuyo kiṃ paṭicca paññāyantī'ti?

11064.meaning1: dependent on the dimension of infinite space; based on the dimension of infinite space
11064.commentary: (MNa) yasmā pana dve vā tīṇi vā ākās'ānañc'āyatanāni vā viññāṇañc'āyatan'ādīni vā n'atthi, tasmā ekattaṃ ekattasitaṃ vibhajanto atthi, bhikkhave, upekkhā ākās'ānañc'āyatananissitā'ti-ādim'āha. (MNt) ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ nissayatī'ti ākās'ānañc'āyatananissitā, ākās'ānañc'āyatanakhandhanissitā.

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, upekkhā ākās'ānañc'āyatananissitā, atthi viññāṇ'añc'āyatananissitā, atthi ākiñcaññ'āyatananissitā, atthi n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatananissitā, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, upekkhā ekattā ekattasitā.

11065.meaningLit: discourse on the question about the dimension of infinite space

11066.meaning1: having the dimension of infinite space as peak; with the base of infinity of space as apex
11066.commentary: (SNa) karuṇāvihārissa uṇh'ābhighāt'ād-irūpanimittaṃ sattadukkhaṃ samanupassantassa karuṇāya pavattisambhavato rūpe ādīnavo parividito hoti, ath'assa parividitarūp'ādīnavattā pathavīkasiṇ'ādīsu aññataraṃ ugghāṭetvā rūpanissaraṇe ākāse cittaṃ upasaṃharato appakasiren'eva tattha cittaṃ pakkhandati. iti karuṇā ākās'ānañc'āyatanassa upanissayo hoti, na tato paraṃ, tasmā ākās'ānañc'āyatanaparamā'ti vuttā.

examples.text: sabbaso vā pana rūpasaññānaṃ samatikkamā paṭighasaññānaṃ atthaṅ'gamā nānattasaññānaṃ amanasikārā ananto ākāso'ti ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. ākās'ānañc'āyatanaparam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, karuṇācetovimuttiṃ vadāmi, idhapaññassa bhikkhuno uttarivimuttiṃ appaṭivijjhato.

11067.meaning1: recognition of dimension of infinite space; perception of dimension of infinite space (in)

examples.text: idha, sandha, bhadrassa puris'ājānīyassa… ākās'ānañc'āyatane ākās'ānañc'āyatanasaññā vibhūtā hoti, viññāṇañc'āyatane viññāṇañc'āyatanasaññā vibhūtā hoti

11068.meaning1: aware of dimension of infinite space; percipient of dimension of infinite space (in)

examples.text: siyā nu kho, bhante, bhikkhuno tathārūpo samādhipaṭilābho yathā… na ākās'ānañc'āyatane ākās'ānañc'āyatanasaññī assa, na viññāṇañc'āyatane viññāṇañc'āyatanasaññī assa

11069.meaning1: attainment of the dimension of infinite space

examples.text: so iti paṭisañcikkhati, ahaṃ kho'mhi ākās'ānañc'āyatanasamāpattiyā lābhī, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū ākās'ānañc'āyatanasamāpattiyā na lābhino'ti. so tāya ākās'ānañc'āyatanasamāpattiyā attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti.
so iti paṭisañcikkhati, ayam'pi kho ākās'ānañc'āyatanasamāpatti abhisaṅkhatā abhisañcetayitā. yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhamman'ti pajānāti.

11070.meaning1: associated with the dimension of infinite space; connected with the base of infinite space

examples.text: so khv'āhaṃ, āvuso, sabbaso ākās'ānañc'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma anantaṃ viññāṇan'ti viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāmi. tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, iminā vihārena viharato ākās'ānañc'āyatanasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.

11071.meaning1: refined and true perception of the dimension of infinite space
11071.sanskrit: ākāśa + ānantya + āyatana + sūkṣma + satya + saṃjñā

examples.text: tassa yā purimā rūpasaññā, sā nirujjhati. ākās'ānañc'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññā tasmiṃ samaye hoti, ākās'ānañc'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hoti. evam'pi sikkhā ekā saññā uppajjati, sikkhā ekā saññā nirujjhati.

11072.meaning1: with a refined and true perception of the dimension of infinite space

examples.text: tassa yā purimā rūpasaññā, sā nirujjhati. ākās'ānañc'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññā tasmiṃ samaye hoti, ākās'ānañc'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hoti. evam'pi sikkhā ekā saññā uppajjati, sikkhā ekā saññā nirujjhati.

11073.meaningLit: discourse on the base of infinite space

11074.meaning1: gone to the dimension of infinite space; epithet of a class of devas

examples.text: ākaṅkheyya ce, gahapatayo, dhammacārī samacārī, aho vat'āhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā ākās'ānañc'āyatan'ūpagānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan'ti, ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ vijjati, yaṃ so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā ākās'ānañc'āyatan'ūpagānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya.

11075.grammar: nt, abstr, from na kiñci, neg
11075.construction:
na > a > ā + ka > ki + iṃ + ci + *ya
akiñci + *ya

examples.text: ākās'āyatanañ'c'eva, viññāṇ'āyatanaṃ tathā, ākiñcaṃ n'eva-saññañ'ca, samāpajji yathākkamaṃ.

11076.construction:
na > a > ā + kiñci + ana + *ya
akiñcana + *ya

examples.text: yā c'āyaṃ, āvuso, appamāṇā cetovimutti, yā ca ākiñcaññā cetovimutti, yā ca suññatā cetovimutti, yā ca animittā cetovimutti, ime dhammā nān'ātthā c'eva nānābyañjanā ca udāhu ek'atthā byañjanam'eva nānan'ti?
katamā c'āvuso, ākiñcaññā cetovimutti? idh'āvuso, bhikkhu sabbaso viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma n'atthi kiñcī'ti ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. ayaṃ vuccat'āvuso, ākiñcaññā cetovimutti.

11077.grammar: nt, abstr, from na kiñcana, neg
11077.construction:
na > a > ā + kiñci + ana + *ya
akiñcana + *ya

examples.text: idha mayaṃ, bhante, yāva'd'eva ākaṅkhāma sabbaso viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma, n'atthi kiñcī'ti ākiñcañña-āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāma
ākiñcaññaṃ pekkhamāno satimā, n'atthī'ti nissāya tarassu oghaṃ, kāme pahāya virato kathāhi, taṇhakkhayaṃ nattam'ah'ābhipassa.

11078.meaning1: insisting on emptiness; adhering to nothingness

11079.meaning1: dimension of nothingness; sphere of emptiness; base of nothingness

examples.text: idha mayaṃ, bhante, yāva'd'eva ākaṅkhāma sabbaso viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma, n'atthi kiñcī'ti ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāma
ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, sunakkhatta, vijjati yaṃ idh'ekacco purisapuggalo ākiñcaññ'āyatana-adhimutto assa.

11080.meaning1: state of the dimension of nothingness; element of the sphere of emptiness

examples.text: evaṃ vutte, aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, yā c'āyaṃ, bhante, ābhādhātu yā ca subhadhātu yā ca ākās'ānañc'āyatanadhātu yā ca viññāṇ'añc'āyatanadhātu yā ca ākiñcaññ'āyatanadhātu yā ca n'evasaññ'ānāsaññ'āyatanadhātu yā ca saññāvedayitanirodhadhātu, imā nu kho, bhante, dhātuyo kiṃ paṭicca paññāyantī'ti?

11081.meaning1: dependent on the dimension of nothingness; based on the sphere of emptiness

examples.text: atthi, bhikkhave, upekkhā ākās'ānañc'āyatananissitā, atthi viññāṇ'añc'āyatananissitā, atthi ākiñcaññ'āyatananissitā, atthi n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatananissitā, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, upekkhā ekattā ekattasitā.

11082.meaningLit: discourse on the question about the dimension of nothingness

11083.meaning1: connected with the dimension of nothingness; concerned with the base of nothingness

examples.text: ākiñcaññ'āyatana-paṭisaṃyuttāya ca pana kathāya kacchamānāya na sussūsati, na sotaṃ odahati, na aññā cittaṃ upaṭṭhāpeti, na ca taṃ purisaṃ bhajati, na ca tena vittiṃ āpajjati.

11084.meaning1: having the dimension of nothingness as peak; with the sphere of emptiness as apex
11084.commentary: (VISM) upekkhāvihārissa pana, sattā sukhitā vā hontu dukkhato vā vimuccantu, sampattasukhato vā mā vimuccantū'ti ābhogābhāvato sukha-dukkh'ādi-param'attha-gāha-vimukha-bhāvato avijjamānaggahaṇadukkhaṃ cittaṃ hoti. ath'assa param'atthagāhato vimukhabhāvaparicitacittassa param'atthato avijjamāna-ggahaṇa-dukkha-cittassa ca anukkam'ādhigataṃ viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma sabhāvato avijjamāne param'atthabhūtassa viññāṇassa abhāve cittaṃ upasaṃharato appakasiren'eva tattha cittaṃ pakkhandati. iti upekkhā ākiñcaññ'āyatanassa upanissayo hoti, na tato paraṃ, tasmā ākiñcaññāyatanaparamā'ti vuttā'ti.

examples.text: sabbaso vā pana viññāṇ'añc'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma n'atthi kiñcī'ti ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharati. ākiñcaññ'āyatanaparam'āhaṃ, bhikkhave, upekkhācetovimuttiṃ vadāmi, idhapaññassa bhikkhuno uttarivimuttiṃ appaṭivijjhato'ti.

11085.meaning1: recognition of dimension of nothingness; perception of dimension of nothingness (in)

examples.text: idha, sandha, bhadrassa puris'ājānīyassa… ākiñcaññ'āyatane ākiñcaññ'āyatanasaññā vibhūtā hoti, n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatane n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatana-saññā vibhūtā hoti

11086.meaning1: aware of dimension of nothingness; percipient of dimension of nothingness (in)

examples.text: siyā nu kho, bhante, bhikkhuno tathārūpo samādhipaṭilābho yathā… na ākiñcaññ'āyatane ākiñcaññ'āyatanasaññī assa, na n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatane n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatana-saññī assa

11087.meaning1: beneficial for the dimension of nothingness; supportive for the base of nothingness

examples.text: ṭhānam'etaṃ vijjati yaṃ taṃsaṃvattanikaṃ viññāṇaṃ assa ākiñcaññ'āyatan'ūpagaṃ. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, paṭhamā ākiñcaññ'āyatanasappāyā paṭipadā akkhāyati.

11088.meaning1: attainment of the dimension of nothingness; attainment of the sphere of emptiness

examples.text: so iti paṭisañcikkhati, ahaṃ kho'mhi ākiñcaññ'āyatanasamāpattiyā lābhī, ime pan'aññe bhikkhū ākiñcaññ'āyatanasamāpattiyā na lābhino'ti. so tāya ākiñcaññ'āyatanasamāpattiyā attān'ukkaṃseti, paraṃ vambheti.
so iti paṭisañcikkhati, ayam'pi kho ākiñcaññ'āyatanasamāpatti abhisaṅkhatā abhisañcetayitā. yaṃ kho pana kiñci abhisaṅkhataṃ abhisañcetayitaṃ tadaniccaṃ nirodhadhamman'ti pajānāti.

11089.meaning1: associated with the dimension of nothingness; connected with the sphere of emptiness

examples.text: so khv'āhaṃ, āvuso, sabbaso ākiñcaññ'āyatanaṃ samatikkamma n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatanaṃ upasampajja viharāmi. tassa mayhaṃ, āvuso, iminā vihārena viharato ākiñcaññ'āyatanasahagatā saññāmanasikārā samudācaranti.

11090.meaning1: connection with the dimension of nothingness; concern with the base of nothingness

examples.text: evam'eva kho, sunakkhatta, n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatan'ādhimuttassa purisapuggalassa ye ākiñcaññ'āyatanasaṃyojane se vante. so evam'assa veditabbo, ākiñcaññ'āyatanasaṃyojanena hi kho visaṃyutto n'evasaññān'āsaññ'āyatan'ādhimutto purisapuggalo'ti.

11091.meaning1: refined and true perception of the dimension of nothingness

examples.text: tassa yā purimā viññāṇ'añc'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññā, sā nirujjhati. ākiñcaññ'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññā tasmiṃ samaye hoti, ākiñcaññ'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hoti. evam'pi sikkhā ekā saññā uppajjati, sikkhā ekā saññā nirujjhati.

11092.meaning1: with a refined and true perception of the dimension of nothingness

examples.text: tassa yā purimā viññāṇ'añc'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññā, sā nirujjhati. ākiñcaññ'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññā tasmiṃ samaye hoti, ākiñcaññ'āyatana-sukhumasacca-saññī'y'eva tasmiṃ samaye hoti. evam'pi sikkhā ekā saññā uppajjati, sikkhā ekā saññā nirujjhati.

11093.meaningLit: discourse on the dimension of nothingness

11094.meaning1: intent on the dimension of nothingness; fixed on the base of nothingness

examples.text: ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ, sunakkhatta, vijjati yaṃ idh'ekacco purisapuggalo ākiñcaññ'āyatan'ādhimutto assa. ākiñcaññ'āyatan'ādhimuttassa kho, sunakkhatta, purisapuggalassa tappatirūpī c'eva kathā saṇṭhāti, tadanudhammañ'ca anuvitakketi, anuvicāreti, tañ'ca purisaṃ bhajati, tena ca vittiṃ āpajjati

11095.meaning1: gone to the dimension of nothingness; epithet of a class of devas

examples.text: ākaṅkheyya ce, gahapatayo, dhammacārī samacārī, aho vat'āhaṃ kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā ākiñcaññāyatan'ūpagānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyyan'ti, ṭhānaṃ kho pan'etaṃ vijjati, yaṃ so kāyassa bhedā paraṃ maraṇā ākiñcaññāyatan'ūpagānaṃ devānaṃ sahabyataṃ upapajjeyya.

11096.meaning1: rebirth into dimension of nothingness; reappearance in the sphere of emptiness
11096.commentary: (MNa) yāva'd'eva ākiñcaññ'āyatan'ūpapattiyā'ti yāva saṭṭhi-kappasahass'āyuparimāṇe ākiñcaññ'āyatanabhave upapatti, tāva'd'eva saṃvattati, na tato uddhaṃ.

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, aggivessana, etadahosi, n'āyaṃ dhammo nibbidāya na virāgāya na nirodhāya na upasamāya na abhiññāya na sambodhāya na nibbānāya saṃvattati, yāva'd'eva ākiñcaññ'āyatan'ūpapattiyā'ti.

11097.meaning2: origin of the state of nothingness

examples.text: yaṃnūna mayaṃ yena gosiṅgasālavanadāyo ten'upasaṅkameyyāma. tattha mayaṃ appasaddā app'ākiṇṇā phāsuṃ vihareyyāmā'ti.
ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho kevaṭṭo gahapatiputto bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, ayaṃ, bhante, nāḷandā iddhā c'eva phītā ca bahujanā ākiṇṇamanussā bhagavati abhippasannā.

11099.meaning1: impure in deed; coarse in action
11099.commentary: (SNa) ākiṇṇakamm'anto'ti evaṃ aparisuddhakamm'anto. akhīṇakamm'anto'ti'pi pāṭho, kakkhaḷakamm'anto'ti attho. (JAa) ākiṇṇakamm'anto'ti kakkhaḷakamm'anto dāruṇakamm'anto. (SNt) ākiṇṇakamm'anto'ti taṇhādiṭṭhi-ādivasena akusalakamm'anto diṭṭhimohataṇh'ādivasena ādito paṭṭhāya kusalakammānaṃ paṭikkhepanato. diṭṭhivasena ca kathinakakkhaḷakharigatattā akhīṇakamm'anto kakkhaḷakamm'anto'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: yv'āyaṃ bhisāni khanati, puṇḍarīkāni bhañjati, evaṃ ākiṇṇakamm'anto, kasmā eso na vuccatī'ti.
